messages:
mira: quick heads-up — we want to consolidate the routing headers across internal endpoints. current mess: `x-rd-route`, `x-rd-route-hint`, and a few `x-rd-route-meta` variants. goal is a single canonical header + graceful SDK fallbacks. thoughts?

alex: is this a rename-only plan or will the payload shape change? cause if we change shape SDKs might need major bumps.

mira: mostly rename + small shape tweak (compact k/v pairs instead of long json blobs). want SDKs to implement 2-release fallback (accept old, emit new) then remove old acceptance.

jing: telemetry snag: some of our sampling tags live inside the route hint today. if we compact we might lose tagging unless we also add a telemetry passthrough. propose `x-rd-route-meta` (compact) + `x-rd-telemetry` for sampling/trace tags.

sasha: :thinking: console UX question — how do we show rollouts? do we show requests split by header form? my worry is metrics will flash when clients upgrade.

mira: good call. plan is feature-flagged rollout in console: show a metric tile 'route header version' and split latency/cost by version. canary-bot can add header-version histograms.

noah: SDK work: python/ts/go need to map old->new automatically on send, but also surface an opt-in flag `emit_new_route_header` so customers can opt out early. breaking only if we remove fallback later.

marie: estimate for Python: ~2 dev-days for mapping + tests + docs. TS ~1.5 days. Go maybe 2.5 days because of header parsing utility needed.

alex: any plan for server-side validation? we should return a warning header `x-rd-deprecation-warning` when old header seen, so we can track adoption without breaking.

jing: yes we can add a lightweight warning and an internal metric `route_header_old_seen` — console can surface adoption % per tenant.

sasha: UX ask: please add a 'migration playbook' link in the rollout tile with exact SDK snippet and curl examples. PMs will need that for customer comms.

mira: will do. action items: 1) eng-platform add metric & warning header (jing) 2) SDKS implement fallback + opt-in flag (noah + SDK owners) 3) console add header-version tile + playbook link (sasha) 4) pkg-bot will schedule a canary rollout for internal services.

pkg-bot: canary scheduled for next Thursday 14:00 UTC against 10% of traffic. see /ops/canary/173900 for logs.

alex: one more — compatibility matrix in the PR please: server version vs SDK minimum supported. we can't silently break older on-prem customers.

mira: agreed. we'll freeze removal date at least 8 weeks after widest recorded adoption. planning doc will include timeline.

noah: i'll start a small opt-in PR for python and link tests. will post PR here when ready.

marie: tagging product for comms: @sasha please coordinate the public migration note when we're +2 stable SDK releases.

sasha: noted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
